scope: All new or materially revised KO->EN/DE persona dialogue, scenarios, listening dialogue, quest copy, culture cards, and future live promotions.

characterDialogue.rule: Preserve semantic/pragmatic spine and character relationship while allowing native word order, idiom, discourse markers, humor form, contractions and modal particles.

spokenDialogue.rule: Create a spoken surface when display text contains chat-only markers or orthography. Never synthesize ㅋㅋ/ㅎㅎ/lol/chat abbreviations mechanically.

questMeaningAndOptions.rule: Preserve pedagogical contrast and Korean meaning closely enough that answer correctness and distractor logic do not change.

grammarExplanation.rule: Prefer clear pedagogical language; accuracy of the Korean grammar function outranks stylistic creativity.

cultureCard.rule: Use natural editorial language while preserving sourced facts, uncertainty, scope and culture-term boundaries.

officialFactOrSafetyNote.rule: Terminology and factual claims require authoritative-source alignment; community corpus supports wording only.

en.relationshipEncoding: Use directness, hedging, names, contractions, rhythm and stance rather than inventing honorific morphology.
en.defaultConversationalRule: Prefer ordinary contractions and spoken collocations when the scene is casual.
avoid: voice phishing as a universal casual label for unrelated scam channels

de.relationshipEncoding: Choose du/Sie from relationship and setting, never mechanically from Korean speech level.
de.defaultConversationalRule: Use natural particles/collocations such as ja, doch, mal, eben, halt only where they serve the actual pragmatic function.
avoid: regional labels treated as universal German

promotionPolicy.legacyGrandfathering: Existing promotion batches 1-38 are not retroactively blocked by this contract.
promotionPolicy.rule: Any scenario batch 39+ promoted through integrate_scenario_batch.py must declare the canonical localization contract and every canonical native-usage topic it depends on. Every declared topic must satisfy the deep-pass gate before live promotion.

ttsBoundary.rule: Localization may prepare spoken-surface text/notes but must not synthesize or overwrite TTS.
